exposure: clinical method of fetal weight estimation (Johnson's formula)
ultrasound method of fetal weight estimation (Hadlock method)
cohort: The study included singleton term mothers with cephalic presentation and intact membranes who had an ultrasound examination within a week of delivery, excluding those with IUFD, multiple gestation, malpresentation, oligo/polyhydramnios, pelvic/abdominal masses, or current weight over 80 Kgs.
finding: Ultrasound was found to be a more reliable and consistent method than clinical estimation for establishing fetal weight at term across various periods of gestation.
cross-section timing: Conducted over a 6-month period; ultrasound examination performed within one week of delivery.
